verdict.rationale: Copilot's agent mode lets it edit files, plan, explore, and execute coding work autonomously (github-copilot-docs-2, github-copilot-docs-3, github-copilot-docs-22), and Autofix can suggest fixes for security issues (github-copilot-docs-13), implying some capacity for code-quality tasks like tests/fixes. However, the evidence never explicitly mentions writing tests, fixing lint errors, resolving merge conflicts, or updating dependencies as concrete supported workflows. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or hands-on proof of test generation, lint-error fixing, merge-conflict resolution, and dependency-update automation.
